name: Web Scrape Planner API
shortDescription: Deterministic crawl planner — batches, per-batch timing, total ETA, and a sample schedule from pages + throughput
description: Agent-native crawl planner computed in pure arithmetic — no fetch, no LLM. /plan takes total pages, throughput (robots Crawl-delay or requested RPS), batch size, concurrency, and a retry-overhead %, and returns effective RPS, batch count, last-batch size, per-batch timing, a total ETA (seconds + human-readable), and a sample batch schedule with cumulative pages and start offsets. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning (why_result_generated, key_factors, invalidators) and sequencing guidance. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.

name: Web Scrape Legal Risk Checker API
shortDescription: Defensive scrape compliance-risk rubric — 0–100 risk score + level from declared robots/ToS/PII/copyright/circumvention facts
description: Agent-native, DEFENSIVE scrape compliance-risk rubric computed deterministically — no LLM. You declare facts about a target (robots disallow, login wall, ToS prohibition, personal/special-category data, copyrighted content, commercial use, access-control circumvention); /assess returns a 0–100 risk score, a legal-risk level (low/moderate/high/severe), per-flag weight contributions, and responsible-scraping guidance. It does NOT help bypass anything — circumvention forces a severe 'do not proceed'. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and compliance steps. EU/UK weight personal data higher. Confidence 0.7 with a legal disclaimer — this is an advisory rubric, not legal advice.

name: Web Scrape Monitoring Scorer API
shortDescription: Recommended re-check cadence + volatility band + monitoring-priority score from change rate, importance, and staleness tolerance
description: Agent-native monitoring-cadence scorer computed in pure arithmetic — no fetch, no LLM. /score takes an observed change signal (change_rate_per_day, or mean_change_interval_days, or changes_observed + observation_window_days), a business importance (low/medium/high/critical or 1–10), and an optional staleness tolerance, and returns a recommended re-check interval (sampled below the change interval, capped by tolerance and a 15-minute politeness floor), checks/day, what the cadence is capped by, a volatility band, and a 0–100 monitoring-priority score with a band. The one-call /lookup adds reasoning and monitoring guidance. Deterministic, confidence 1.0.

name: Country & Currency Data API
shortDescription: Deterministic ISO-3166 / ISO-4217 reference + money formatter over a curated static dataset — no LLM, no network
description: Agent-native country/currency reference and money formatter over a curated static ISO-3166 / ISO-4217 dataset — pure lookups and string math, no LLM, no network. /country resolves a country by name, ISO2/ISO3, numeric code, or dial code (with its currency). /currency resolves an ISO-4217 currency and lists which countries use it. /format renders a monetary amount with the correct symbol and minor units (deterministic grouping, no ICU dependency). The one-call /lookup resolves country + currency and optionally formats an amount, with reasoning. Confidence 1.0 — no FX rates, formatting only.

name: Finance Payments API
shortDescription: Deterministic payments math — installment/amortization, processor fee split + gross-up, exact multi-party settlement (sums to the penny)
description: Agent-native payments math computed in real arithmetic — no LLM. /installment amortizes a loan (monthly payment, total interest, total paid, schedule). /fee-split computes a processor fee (percent + fixed), net settlement, effective fee %, and an optional gross-up (what to charge to net a target). /settlement splits an amount across parties by weight or share % using largest-remainder allocation that sums exactly to the penny. The one-call /lookup amortizes and applies an optional per-payment processor fee, with reasoning. Confidence 1.0; informational, not financial advice.
